verses.1: Hear the heavens, and they will speak; and the earth will hear the words spoken.
verses.2: I will cover it with a mat. I’ll take some tar and apply it there. I said, “When they are on the trees and on the bushes.”
verses.3: For the name of the LORD is great; we must exalt His name.
verses.4: The righteous act in accordance with justice; all their ways are based on truth. There is no harm done to the righteous and the upright.
verses.5: He did not give him his children; instead, he caused trouble and chaos in his household.
verses.6: May Jehovah reward you for this, oh fool! He who is not wise… Your father has given you birth; he created you and nurtured you.
verses.7: Remember the days of a thousand years, in those countless years your father lived. Your elders will tell you about them, and they will say to you:
verses.8: In the valley of Ono, among the nations, when people are divided, the boundaries of the nations will be set forth according to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.9: For part of Jehovah’s people, Jacob, is the thread that binds their inheritance together.
verses.10: He will be found in the land of the desert. In his valley, the shofan bird will sing. They will plant him there and create a garden for him, just like they do with a human being.
verses.11: When the crow rises from its nest, it will fly away with its wings spread out. It will be carried onto its back.
verses.12: Yehovah alone will dwell with us; there is no other god worthy of worshiping beside Him.
verses.13: It will ride on the dead land; it will eat the crops from the fields. It will also pick up dirt from the rocks and wine from the springs.
verses.14: Honey from flowers, and milk from sheep and goats. Also, blood from pigs and oxen. And wine made from grapes. All these things should be mixed with honey.
verses.15: And Yishurun stood up, and he struck the ground with his hands. Then Eloah created him from that ground. And He formed his body from clay.
verses.16: He will be hated by foreigners, and they will torment him.
verses.17: They will worship idols. They do not know God. They do not understand anything new. They came from afar; their gates are empty. Your ancestors have left them behind.
verses.18: Create your child in a way that he/she will remember you as his/her Savior.
verses.19: And Jehovah saw that his anger had been turned away from his sons and daughters.
verses.20: And Esdras said, “Turn away from them! I will see what will happen to them later. For in that day, those children will not be believed in at all.”
verses.21: They envied me without any reason. They angered me with their actions. But I will avenge them, even though they are in a wicked land. I will make them pay for their actions.
verses.22: For fire burned in my nostrils, and it spread all the way down to Sheol. It consumed the land and its inhabitants, and it set ablaze the foundations of the mountains.
verses.23: May he be filled with evil and suffering.
verses.24: I will send them along with the scabies and bitter worms. I will also send them along with those who are infested with lice.
verses.25: From outside, there’s chaos and fear; from within the walls, there’s also terror. It’s a situation where one must live with someone who is full of hatred.
verses.26: I said, “Let them be destroyed by human hands, so that their memories will be forgotten.”
verses.27: Let me not be angry or resentful. Let them not be punished for their actions. Let them not say that our hands are right, and that God did not do anything about it.
verses.28: For a nation that destroys many trees, there is no hope for it.
verses.29: If only they were wise and understanding, then they would understand this for their future benefit.
verses.30: How many will be destroyed by one thousand, and two thousand will be destroyed as well. Unless their forms are changed through trade. And God will destroy them.
verses.31: For their forms are not like ours, and our flaws are also different from theirs.
verses.32: Because from the vines come their grapes, and from the trees of Amorah come their fruits. They are bitter fruits that cause pain.
verses.33: Their hearts are like those of foxes; their heads are like those of vipers.
verses.34: He wasn’t like those who stood before me, with their hands in their pockets.
verses.35: I will take revenge and make amends when their feet are numb from walking. For the day of their destruction is near, and they will suffer greatly.
verses.36: For Jehovah will have mercy on His people and on His servants, when they see that their hands are freed from bondage and they are no longer trapped.
verses.37: And he said, “May the Lord’s curse be upon him!”
verses.38: May those who eat their offerings drink wine. May they be raised up and help you. May there be protection over you.
verses.39: Look now, I am here. There is no God beside me. I heal and save those who are sick. And no one can save them from my hands.
verses.40: For if I ask the heavens for help, and say, “I will live forever,”
verses.41: If I change my ways in the last moments before destruction, and if I hold onto justice in my hands, then I will take revenge for those who suffer and for those who are hated.
verses.42: He will be hired with half blood; he will eat flesh that is of blood. He will be a slave from the beginning, and he will be hated by all kings.
verses.43: Let us destroy those nations, along with their people. For the blood of their servants will be avenged, and their suffering will be relieved. Let their land be desolate!
verses.44: And Moses came and spoke all these words of the Torah to the people. He also comforted them.
verses.45: And Moses was able to speak all these things to all the Israelites.
verses.46: And he said to them, “Consider carefully all the things that I am about to testify to you today. When you command your children to keep all the commandments of this Torah.”
verses.47: For it is not something that exists outside of you; it comes from you. In this matter, you will live for many days on the land that you cross across the Jordan to possess.
verses.48: And the LORD spoke to Moses on this very day, as follows:
verses.49: I ascended to this mountain of the Abarim, Mount Nebo. It is located in the land of Moab. From there, I saw the land of Canaan, which I have given to the children of Israel as a possession.
verses.50: And from that mountain, which you climb to reach its summit, your people will be gathered together. Just as your brother Aaron died on that mountain, so too will your people be gathered together with their tribes.
verses.51: For you have built me up among the children of Israel, in the land of the Holy Place by the River Jordan. But you did not sanctify me among the children of Israel.
verses.52: For from there you will see the land, but you shall not enter into the land that I give to the children of Israel.
